title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Sure of Yourself and Still Get on Your Knees
caption:
Confidence and humility aren't opposites. They're the same muscle, pointed two different directions.

A man secure enough to know his worth is also secure enough to hear he was wrong. The insecure guy can't do either. He's too busy managing how he looks.

Get sure enough in Christ that you don't need to be right in the room anymore.

#faith #humility #christianmen #character #manofgod
